description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of a pine dune floor: pale sand with small tufts of heather and dry grass, fallen pine needles and a few pine cones, muted dark palette of sand, heather purple and pine green, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
